note: First real run against manifest.json's 12 fixtures. MAE is well above the constitution's 5% gate — expected, not a regression: these expected_calories values are manually reconstructed estimates (see README.md), not lab measurements, and the model's own run-to-run variance is real (no temperature control available on this model — see app/services/vision_models.py). Treat this as the reference point for catching a GROSS future regression (e.g. MAE roughly doubling), not as evidence the pipeline is within 5% of true values.
known_anomaly: pastrami_sandwich_rye.jpg scored 100% error (actual=0) in this run because the real pipeline correctly triggered a clarifying_question for it (calorie_vision.md rules 6/12 — this is the fixture that motivated those rules) and this baseline script, like tests/test_calorie_accuracy.py, does not simulate answering it. A second call with the clarification answered would score very differently. This is a pre-existing test-harness gap, not specific to any recent change.
